jsonld.name: Holy Moly Pressure Washing
jsonld.description: Pressure washing and soft washing company based in Clearwater, FL: driveways, walkways, patios, roofs, pool decks and fences.

parrafo.es: Lavamos a presión y a baja presión (soft wash) entradas, caminos, patios, techos, terrazas de piscina y cercas en Clearwater. Evan llega puntual, cotiza sin rodeos y deja la superficie lista, sin dañarla.
parrafo.en: We pressure wash and soft wash driveways, walkways, patios, roofs, pool decks and fences around Clearwater. Evan shows up on time, gives a straight quote, and leaves every surface clean without damaging it.

hero.imagen_alt: Holy Moly Pressure Washing lavando a presión un patio de pavers en Clearwater, FL

parrafo_1.es: Holy Moly Pressure Washing es un negocio de Clearwater, Florida, fundado en 2020. Evan hace el trabajo él mismo: atiende el teléfono, cotiza y limpia, sin intermediarios ni call center.
parrafo_1.en: Holy Moly Pressure Washing is a Clearwater, Florida business founded in 2020. Evan does the work himself: he answers the phone, quotes the job and cleans it, no middlemen and no call center.

parrafo_2.es: Usa la técnica según la superficie: presión alta para concreto y pavers, y soft wash (baja presión, con producto) para techos y madera, para no dañarlos. Así lo reflejan sus 42 reseñas en Google, todas de 5 estrellas.
parrafo_2.en: He matches the technique to the surface: high pressure for concrete and pavers, and soft washing (low pressure, with solution) for roofs and wood, so nothing gets damaged. That is what his 42 five-star Google reviews describe.

texto.es: Cuéntanos qué quieres lavar: entrada, techo, terraza, cerca. Evan responde directo, sin formularios.
texto.en: Tell us what needs washing: driveway, roof, patio, fence. Evan answers directly, no forms.

texto.es: Te da un precio concreto según el trabajo, sin letra chica. Varias reseñas destacan lo justo de sus precios.
texto.en: He gives a concrete price for the job, no fine print. Several reviews call out his fair, reasonable pricing.

texto.es: Presión alta en concreto y pavers, soft wash en techos y madera. Cada superficie se trata distinto para no dañarla.
texto.en: High pressure on concrete and pavers, soft washing on roofs and wood. Each surface gets treated differently so nothing gets damaged.

texto.es: Terminas con la superficie como nueva. Es el cambio que describen una y otra vez sus clientes en Google.
texto.en: You end up with a surface that looks brand new. It is the kind of change his customers describe again and again on Google.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza según el tamaño y la superficie. Llama o escribe al +1 (727) 426-4386 y te damos el precio sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on size and surface. Call or text +1 (727) 426-4386 and we will give you a price, no obligation.

texto.es: Lavado a presión de concreto y pavers: quitamos manchas de óxido, moho y suciedad acumulada hasta dejar la superficie como nueva.
texto.en: Pressure washing for concrete and pavers: we lift rust stains, mold and built-up grime until the surface looks new again.

texto.es: Techos de teja y de asfalto, limpiados a baja presión para quitar manchas sin levantar ni dañar las tejas.
texto.en: Tile and shingle roofs, cleaned with low-pressure soft washing to remove stains without lifting or damaging the shingles.

texto.es: Limpieza de terrazas, jaulas de piscina (screen enclosures) y áreas con moho o acumulación difícil.
texto.en: Cleaning for pool decks, screened pool cages and areas with stubborn mold or buildup.

texto.es: Lavado de decks y cercas de madera con la presión adecuada para no astillar ni desgastar la madera.
texto.en: Wood deck and fence washing with the right pressure so the wood does not splinter or wear down.

pie.es: ¿No ves tu superficie en la lista? Llama igual, seguro la limpiamos.
pie.en: Do not see your surface listed? Call anyway, chances are we clean it.

items.quote: Evan does great work. 10/10 recommend him for any and all pressure washing. He pressure washed our driveway, front patio, entire house but especially the areas that were in desperate need, pool patio and walkway. It's truly an amazing difference!

Evan was very responsive and punctual. Our 20,00 gal. pool had developed a leak so we were unable to use the pool pump and filter resulting in it turning green. You can see from the before and after photos what a great job he did! We would definitely recommend Evan and “Holy Moly” pressure washing to everyone!

Wow! Evan did an amazing job on my driveway, sidewalks, deck, pool deck, and fence. Everything is so bright and looks so brand new! I will not hesitate to use him again, and I highly recommend his services!
